name: 战国
feature: 七雄并立：齐楚燕韩赵魏秦，变法图强、合纵连横；百家争鸣达于鼎盛，儒道墨法交辉。列主要诸子，合计约254年。
featureEn: Seven powers vied — Qi, Chu, Yan, Han, Zhao, Wei, Qin; reforms and vertical/horizontal alliances; the Hundred Schools peaked, with Confucian, Daoist, Mohist and Legalist thought shining. Major thinkers, ~254 yrs.
summary: 大争之世，制度与思想双重井喷，为秦汉一统蓄势。
summaryEn: An age of contention; institutions and thought erupted together, setting the stage for Qin–Han unification.

思想·文人.noteEn: Second sage of Confucianism; argued for innate goodness and benevolent rule
Daoist representative; ease and the equality of things
Between Confucian and Legalist; theory of evil nature
Yin–Yang school; cycle of the five virtues
Logicians; “a white horse is not a horse”

文臣.noteEn: Reformed Qin; rewarded farming and war
Reformed Wei; farmed the land fully

武将.noteEn: Military strategist; “besiege Wei to rescue Zhao”

其他.noteEn: Father of Chu ci; the Li Sao

政治: 七雄并立，变法图强，军功爵制取代世卿
合纵连横，外交博弈决定兴衰
经济: 铁器牛耕普及，井田瓦解，小农经济兴起
货币多样，工商业城市繁荣
文化: 百家争鸣：儒道墨法阴阳名家并起
楚辞、诸子散文成就文学高峰

政治: Seven powers vied; reform strengthened; merit titles replaced hereditary ones
Vertical and horizontal alliances — diplomacy decided rise and fall
经济: Iron tools and ox-plough spread; the well-field fell; smallholder economy rose
Diverse coinage; commerce and cities flourished
文化: The Hundred Schools contended: Confucian, Daoist, Mohist, Legalist, Yin–Yang, Logicians
Chu ci and the prose of the philosophers reached a literary peak
